capabilities: Match words in note titles, bodies, and properties against a thesaurus of terms and synonyms
Add the matching term as a tag to the note
Load the thesaurus from a CSV file or a Markdown table in the vault
Parse the current file or all files in included paths (regex supported)
Exclude terms via a frontmatter key, with optional auto-clean of existing tags
disambiguation: Not a synonym lookup or writing aid; the thesaurus file is only used to decide which tags to add to notes.
extras: Installable via BRAT or from the release page in addition to community plugins; interface available in English and French. Warns that moving the thesaurus file requires manually updating its path in settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to apply tags automatically from a controlled vocabulary of terms and synonyms.
summary: Tag automation plugin that adds tags to notes by matching their title, body, and properties against a CSV or Markdown thesaurus of synonyms.
